breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the conflicting instructions regarding the grid definition in the preamble. The original prompt provided a general rule, then an incorrect override for the specific task. The agent resolved this by completely omitting the confusing preamble and only stating the correct grid definition for this specific problem (`dx = 1/Nx`), which is consistent with the ground truth's approach of removing the contradictory text.
